title: Carry pinned upstream source into a standalone rebuild
summary: Make transferred archives reproducible from a clean adopter checkout by resolving only their declared source pins.
benefits: Cross-repo archive moves can be checked without a pre-seeded checkout.
risks: A remote object can be unavailable; document the failure and preserve the original pin.

evidence.claim: The hardening branch checks for each pinned public AlderVale commit and fetches the missing object.
